Container.Name: onepacerr
Container.Overview:
Automates One Pace downloads, organization, and metadata for Jellyfin (default), Plex, Emby, or a local folder.
Read https://github.com/eltharynd/OnePacerr#readme for initial setup and environment variables, especially the first-run pipeline settings.
Configure your media server and torrent client credentials using reachable URLs (not localhost), or enable Skip downloads for an existing library.
Data maps /mnt/user/data to /data; adjust it to include your library and downloads. If other containers use different paths, set both fields in each mapping pair in Advanced View; otherwise leave both empty. Hardlinks require the same filesystem and volume mount.
Runs as 99:100 via Extra Parameters; needs download read access and library read/write access. No appdata volume required. Configure through environment variables; WebUI opens a JSON status report.

Config.Name: Status API port
Config.Description: JSON status and health API. There is no graphical configuration interface.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Existing share containing your library and torrent downloads. For example, /mnt/user/data/media/tv becomes /data/media/tv inside OnePacerr.

Config.Name: Media server
Config.Description: Select your media server, or none to organize a local folder. Fill in only the selected server's settings.

Config.Name: Series name
Config.Description: Series name in your media server and default series folder name.

Config.Name: Use hardlinks
Config.Description: Enable upstream's hardlink import option. Downloads and library must share the same filesystem and Docker volume mount, such as the single /data mount. Defaults to copying. See the GitHub README for details.

Config.Name: Local library root
Config.Description: Used only with media server none. Parent directory of the series folder, inside the Data mount.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Required for plex, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:32400. Use an address reachable from the container, not localhost.

Config.Name: Plex token
Config.Description: Required for plex. Authentication token for your Plex server.

Config.Name: Plex library name
Config.Description: Exact name of the TV library in Plex.

Config.Name: Jellyfin URL
Config.Description: Required for jellyfin, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8096. Do not use localhost.

Config.Name: Jellyfin username
Config.Description: Required for jellyfin. Account with permission to update library metadata.

Config.Name: Jellyfin password
Config.Description: Required for jellyfin. Password for the selected account.

Config.Name: Jellyfin library name
Config.Description: Exact name of the TV library in Jellyfin.

Config.Name: Emby URL
Config.Description: Required for emby, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8096. Do not use localhost.

Config.Name: Emby username
Config.Description: Required for emby. Account with permission to update library metadata.

Config.Name: Emby password
Config.Description: Required for emby. Password for the selected account.

Config.Name: Emby library name
Config.Description: Exact name of the TV library in Emby.

Config.Name: Torrent client
Config.Description: Torrent client with its WebUI/API enabled. Deluge also needs its Label plugin enabled.

Config.Name: Torrent client URL
Config.Description: Required unless Skip downloads is true. Use a reachable URL, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8080, not localhost.

Config.Name: Torrent username
Config.Description: Torrent client WebUI username, if the client uses one.

Config.Name: Torrent password
Config.Description: Torrent client WebUI password.

Config.Name: Skip downloads
Config.Description: True disables torrent client integration and processes only your existing library.

Config.Name: Media server library path
Config.Description: Library root as reported by your media server, e.g. /tv. Set together with OnePacerr library path, or leave BOTH empty when paths match.

Config.Name: OnePacerr library path
Config.Description: Equivalent library root inside this container, e.g. /data/media/tv. Must exist under the Data mount. Set together with Media server library path.

Config.Name: Torrent client download path
Config.Description: Download root as reported by the torrent client, e.g. /downloads. Set together with OnePacerr download path, or leave BOTH empty when paths match.

Config.Name: OnePacerr download path
Config.Description: Equivalent download root inside this container, e.g. /data/torrents. Set together with Torrent client download path.

Config.Name: Skip existing file verification
Config.Description: False hashes existing episodes to check for updated releases. Can take time on large libraries.

Config.Name: Skip existing file organization
Config.Description: False organizes and renames episodes already in the library.

Config.Name: Skip existing metadata updates
Config.Description: False refreshes metadata for episodes already in the library. New imports still receive metadata when true.

Config.Name: Skip posters
Config.Description: True disables poster updates.

Config.Name: Include specials
Config.Description: Also process special episodes.

Config.Name: Prefer extended cuts
Config.Description: Prefer extended cuts when available.

Config.Name: Prefer alternate cuts
Config.Description: Prefer the alternate G-8 cut at the end of Skypiea.

Config.Name: Skip supplements
Config.Description: Skip alternate edits that supplement incomplete arcs.

Config.Name: Include filters
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated filters, e.g. S01,S02E01. Empty includes all episodes.

Config.Name: Exclude filters
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated filters, e.g. S35,S36.

Config.Name: Series folder name
Config.Description: Optional override. Empty uses Series name.

Config.Name: Create missing series
Config.Description: Automatically create the series if missing from your media server.

Config.Name: Plex skip metadata files
Config.Description: For Plex, update metadata through its API without writing NFO and poster files. False also writes those files.

Config.Name: Torrent category
Config.Description: Category for downloads managed by OnePacerr.

Config.Name: Completed torrent category
Config.Description: Category assigned after importing completed downloads.

Config.Name: Torrent check interval
Config.Description: Seconds between checks for completed downloads.

Config.Name: Torrent request timeout
Config.Description: Seconds to wait for a torrent client response.

Config.Name: Metadata poster set
Config.Description: Poster set identifier, e.g. default, official, or mizzoufan523. See the project's poster set documentation.

Config.Name: Metadata .nfo lock
Config.Description: Prevents media servers from overwriting generated NFO files.

Config.Name: Disable metadata WebSocket
Config.Description: True uses periodic metadata polling instead of live updates.

Config.Name: Metadata check interval
Config.Description: Polling interval in seconds; used only when metadata WebSocket is disabled.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: Application log verbosity. Read output through Unraid's container logs.
